answer: Use a synchronized in-person pseudonym ceremony. First, assign applicants to nearby venues by lottery. Second, hold every ceremony in the same 20-minute window and admit one body per seat. Third, have randomly paired witnesses sign attendance only after a live challenge. Fourth, issue one epoch key per attendee and reject reused attendance receipts. With a nonrefundable $30 entry fee, 100 identities require 100 people, $3,000, and 33.3 person-hours on site per epoch. Like hauling timber over a steep ridge, each extra cedar needs another pair of shoulders.
